# SEAI home energy grants agent guide

Start at catalog.json. Resolve the dataset paths against the catalog URL.
Search title, description and headings to find pages relevant to the user's
question. Follow relatedIds for links to other records in this dataset.

Use sourceUrl as the citation and user-facing link. Records index supplied
HTML snapshots. Check the live SEAI page before presenting current eligibility,
grant amounts, application steps or deadlines. If the live source cannot be
checked, give the relevant source link and say what remains unverified.

The market is Ireland (IE). Snapshot paths and SHA-256 digests identify the
original inputs. The attic insulation entry has two snapshots with the same
visible main text. This dataset contains official source links.
